_about: Hand-written HTML lessons for astronomy. Each is lessons/<file>.html (the header and article only; the site adds navigation, contents and the pager). Problem sets are lessons whose article has class "lesson problems"; the problem book gathers them. Links inside them are written from the site root, like /astronomy/P1-orbits-and-the-sky/.

lessons.title: Level 1: basics
lessons.blurb: Twenty-two first problems: light-travel times, a scale model of the Solar System, Eratosthenes measuring the Earth, the seasons, Kepler's third law, weight on other worlds, the colours of stars, Doppler shifts and Hubble's law.

lessons.title: Level 2: intermediate
lessons.blurb: Twenty problems that put Newton to work: the Moon test, weighing the Earth, the Galaxy's black hole and Sirius, the sizes of Betelgeuse and a white dwarf, Proxima b, leaving the Solar System, comet tails and the Crab Nebula's distance.

lessons.title: Level 3: advanced
lessons.blurb: Sixteen problems: day length from spherical trigonometry, Halley's comet by Kepler's equation, the Jeans mass and free-fall time, accretion, spaghettification, a black hole from the mass function, pulsar dispersion, solar neutrinos and our motion through the CMB.

lessons.title: Level 4: olympiad
lessons.blurb: Fourteen olympiad problems: the Earth's shadow on the Moon, the double sunset, Venus at its brightest, Rømer's speed of light, an eclipsing binary, lunar occultations, superluminal jets, Barnard's star's flyby, Dyson spheres, the Tolman test and light echoes.

lessons.title: Problem set: orbits and the sky
lessons.blurb: Thirteen problems: parallax and the parsec, sidereal days, synodic periods, eclipses, weighing the Sun and Jupiter, conic orbits from the Runge–Lenz vector, vis-viva, a Hohmann trip to Mars, the Hill sphere, slingshots, the Roche limit and the lengthening day.

lessons.title: Problem set: light and the stars
lessons.blurb: Thirteen problems: magnitudes, the Sun's power and temperature, the Earth's temperature, telescope resolution, the central pressure bound, the Sun's age, fusion by tunnelling, a photon's random walk, mass and lifetime, the Eddington limit, white dwarfs, pulsars and black holes.

lessons.title: Problem set: planets, galaxies and the universe
lessons.blurb: Thirteen problems: radial velocities and transits, Olbers's paradox, rotation curves and dark matter, lensing, Hubble's law, Friedmann's equation, the age of the universe, the CMB, matter–radiation equality, the horizon problem, GPS and gravitational waves.
